import hashlib,json,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd().parent.parent
assert (repo/'python/tools/watchfiles_contracts.py').exists(), repo
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'python'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'python/tools'))
from watchfiles_contracts import _native_case
cases=json.loads((repo/'go/testdata/python-watchfiles.json').read_text())['native_events']
case=next(c for c in cases if c['name']==sys.argv[1])
recipe={k:v for k,v in case.items() if k not in ('changed','closed','native_arguments')}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mini-loop-immediate-source-') as scratch:
    started=time.monotonic()
    result=_native_case(Path(scratch).resolve()/case['name'],recipe)
    result['seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
    result['matches_pinned_fixture']=result['changed']==case['changed']
    result['fixture_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((repo/'go/testdata/python-watchfiles.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print('IMMEDIATE_SOURCE_COMPARISON '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    out=Path('/tmp/mini-loop-immediate-source-comparisons');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (out/(case['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
